summary: Senior Product Manager with a track record of owning core payments infrastructure end to end, from a Faster Payments integration that cut settlement failures by 34% to a claims flow redesign that reduced chargeback disputes 18%. Experienced leading cross-functional teams of engineers and designers, with a strong analytical foundation in SQL and product analytics to drive decisions from data rather than assumptions.

bullets: Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
